name: First-Time Setup — Connect with create-app
query: I want to start using Conductor but I don't have anything set up yet
expected_behavior: Step 1: Resolve the CLI per Rule 3, asking before installing anything, and use the resulting `conductor` path for every later command

Step 2: Run `conductor config list`. No profiles and no server named → use Developer Edition (`https://developer.orkescloud.com`, profile `developer`) and say so in one line, inviting a URL for another server

Step 3: Tell the user the browser will open to sign in and click **Approve**, then run `conductor create-app --server https://developer.orkescloud.com --profile developer` itself, with a long timeout. No key or secret is typed, pasted or printed
Step 4: Verify with `conductor --profile developer whoami` and `conductor --profile developer workflow list --json`
Step 5: If create-app times out (browser on another machine), give the printed `?setup=key` link and have the user run interactive `conductor config save --profile developer` in their own terminal
success_criteria: Connection uses `conductor create-app` run by the agent; sending the user to create an access key in the UI and save it with `config save` as the main path fails this criterion (it is only the timeout fallback)
Developer Edition is the default only because no profiles exist and no server was named, and the agent says so
No `localhost` profile or local server is set up unasked
Credential values never enter chat, agent tool input, command arguments, clipboard reads, or raw-profile inspection
Verification uses a real authenticated call with `--profile developer`
